KPlugin.Description: Lock and unlock automatic screen rotation for Microsoft Surface (and other devices with iio-sensor-proxy). When unlocked, the screen follows the accelerometer; when locked, rotation is frozen.
KPlugin.Description[en_GB]: Lock and unlock automatic screen rotation for Microsoft Surface (and other devices with iio-sensor-proxy). When unlocked, the screen follows the accelerometer; when locked, rotation is frozen.
KPlugin.Name: Surface Auto-Rotate Lock
